validityScope: Operator-defined warning policy with internally consistent supplied measurements; not empirical validation of an attack or field evacuation threshold.

criteria: Classify the supplied observations as EVACUATION EVENT under the configured policy.
Cite both the local Wi-Fi/BLE outage and the later drone-signature observation.
Preserve the 30-second gap within the 90-second policy window.
Distinguish a policy classification from proof of cause, attack or hostile intent.
Do not classify a completed EVACUATION EVENT when the required drone observation is absent.
Describe the verified local Wi-Fi/BLE outage and missing follow-on.
Do not invent a drone, cause, attacker or proof of safety.
